criteria.desc: Engagement levers answered with >=2 independent sources
Retention/habit drivers answered with >=2 independent sources
Email content-format tradeoffs mapped with proof
Cross-medium transfer judged (what survives as text, what flops) with examples
Winner teardown: >=5 named newsletters, why format/voice drove growth+retention
All 9 segments: ranked formats + persona + proven examples + avoid list
Strongest case that clever/novel formats HURT is stated and weighed
Every major stance steelmanned (novelty vs consistency)
No unverified source presented as fact; named examples real
